description: ResNet-34 layout (BasicBlocks [3,4,6,3], 3x3 stride-1 stem, 112->7) + BN embedding head + ArcFace(s=32, m=0.4, margin warmup 5 ep). Trained on PSC Bridges-2 V100.
observations: Train/val accuracy gap grew to ~5 points (98.1 vs 93.4): late-epoch overfitting.
Val EER bottomed at 2.04% around epoch 20 and drifted up to 3.46% by epoch 50.
Classification error costs ~3.4 score points, EER ~1.5.
